explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain precisely why the objective drops from 10755.0 to 10475.0 instead of increasing after adding peak-hour energy charges. Your answer must identify the exact new code variables and objective term(s) added in `src/current_heuristic.py` (including `x_peak[(p,t)]` and `q[(p,t)]`), trace them to the literal business terms and CSV field names `normal_hours_cap_fraction_q*`, `peak_hours_cap_q*`, and `peak_cost_per_hour_q*`, and compare the original and revised solutions using the visible inventory states (e.g., `inv_II_2`, `inv_II_3`) plus at least one binding/slack capacity interpretation from solver output. Also state the business meaning of the relevant marginal values/reduced costs for a zero backlog or inventory variable, and explain why you cannot linearly extrapolate the -280 improvement from one quarter’s shadow-price logic alone.
